description: This Java class, MessageCommandResponseSignalMapper, extends AbstractMessageSignalMapper and is responsible for mapping message command responses into signals by extracting subjects, status codes, and message headers.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractMessageSignalMapper that maps MessageCommandResponse objects into signals by extracting key message attributes.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject string from the message within the command response.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the optional HttpStatusCode from the message within the command response.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Extracts the message headers from the message within the command response.
